title: Viva Insights: Copilot Studio agents report adds autonomous agents and time and cost savings
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing prerequisites, data-sharing controls and automation match the sources checked. It accurately reports Microsoft's conflicting statements about autonomous-agent coverage; one supporting citation should be added for maker-configured savings inputs.

claims.quote: "status": "Launched", "statusKey": "launched"

claims.claim: The release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.claim: The roadmap target is October CY2025.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "October CY2025"

claims.claim: The roadmap supplies no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The report adds autonomous-agent adoption and impact, including time and cost savings.
claims.quote: The Copilot Studio agent report includes autonomous agents and provides insights on adoption, impact, time savings, and cost savings.

claims.claim: The Copilot Studio agents report is a Power BI template in Viva Insights advanced analysis.
claims.quote: In the Viva Insights analyst experience, select Create analysis. Under Power BI templates, navigate to Copilot Studio agents report and select Set up analysis.

claims.claim: The report defines autonomous agents as Copilot Studio agents with defined event triggers.
claims.quote: Autonomous agents are agents built in Copilot Studio with defined event triggers.

claims.claim: Autonomous Agent Impact shows sessions over time and successful and unsuccessful outcomes.
claims.quote: The chart on the left shows the number of sessions over time, and you can toggle between this and agent session outcomes based on successful and unsuccessful outcomes.

claims.claim: Autonomous Agent Impact shows average completion time.
claims.quote: The chart in the center of the page highlights the average completion time for the selected timeframe

claims.claim: Autonomous Agent Impact shows sessions per trigger and per action.
claims.quote: The chart on the right shows the number of sessions per trigger for the agent in the selected timeframe ... as well as the option to select the number of sessions per action for the agent in the selected time frame

claims.claim: Autonomous Agent Impact includes estimated agent-assisted impact in Agent Assisted Hours.
claims.quote: Estimated agent assisted impact, which reflects the cumulative Agent Assisted Hours (AAH) that might be achieved through the deployment of the autonomous agent.

claims.claim: The February 24, 2026 release notes announce autonomous agents with generative orchestration and new adoption, time and cost metrics.
claims.quote:
February 24, 2026
What changed: The agent report now includes autonomous agents with generative orchestration. It also offers new metrics related to adoption, time saved, and cost benefits.

claims.claim: Makers configure savings inputs in Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: In Copilot Studio, you can calculate how much time or money an agent saves compared to other methods.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/analytics-cost-savings to sources for the statement that maker-led savings inputs are set in Copilot Studio.

claims.claim: Maker-led savings inputs are passed to Viva Insights.
claims.quote: Maker-led inputs are passed to Viva Insights and Viva Insights reflects the updated value.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Maker-led values cannot be edited with the Viva Insights calculator.
claims.quote: Maker-led values are not editable in Viva Insights.

claims.claim: When maker inputs are absent, Viva Insights infers autonomous-agent impact from Agent assisted hours.
claims.quote: In the absence of maker-provided inputs, Agent-assisted Impact is inferred using Agent assisted hours (AAH).

claims.claim: Information-retrieval time savings default to six minutes per knowledge-source reference.
claims.quote: Time saved in information retrieval: This is estimated by multiplying the number of times knowledge sources were referenced with the information retrieval time savings multiplier, which is six minutes.

claims.claim: Inferred autonomous-agent savings include actions performed, weighted by action-specific time savings.
claims.quote: Time saved in performing actions: This is estimated by multiplying the number of times an action was performed by an agent, multiplied by the time savings multiplier for that particular action type.

claims.claim: Successful sessions without independent actions use a generic multiplier of about 2.8 minutes.
claims.quote: The generic time savings multiplier (TimeSavings_Generic) is about 2.8 minutes, which is calculated by getting weighted averages of the time savings for most frequently performed actions

claims.claim: Estimated cost impact is Agent assisted hours multiplied by an hourly rate.
claims.quote: This is an estimate of the value of an agent's impact over the given time period, calculated by multiplying Agent assisted hours by an average hourly rate.

claims.claim: The default hourly value is $72, based on U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics data.
claims.quote: By default, this hourly rate is set to $72, based on data compiled by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: An analyst can change the time-savings multiplier for a particular agent using its calculator.
claims.quote: To edit the value of the multiplier, select the calculator, where you'll see a breakdown of how this metric is calculated for a specific agent. If you change the value, it updates the value for that particular agent.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: An analyst can change the hourly rate for a particular agent.
claims.quote: If you change the value, it updates the hourly rate for that particular agent. You can't use the calculator for maker-led inputs.

claims.quote: The report isn't available for agents using generative orchestration, including autonomous agents or agents that extend Microsoft Copilot.

claims.quote: Ensure that data from Copilot Studio flows to Viva Insights. By default, Copilot Studio data flows to Viva Insights.

claims.quote: This report is enabled for tenants who meet the following eligibility criteria:

claims.quote: When On, enables Copilot Studio data to flow to Microsoft Viva Insights for analytical reports. Also requires Microsoft 365 services to be turned on.

claims.claim: Cross-geo sharing must be enabled when the Viva Insights preferred location differs from the Copilot Studio environment location.
claims.quote: If your tenant's preferred data location for Viva Insights is different from the location of your Copilot Studio environment, turn on Cross-geo boundary sharing to allow cross-geo boundary sharing of aggregated analytics data.

claims.claim: Cross-geo sharing defaults to Off.
claims.quote:
EnableCopilotStudioCrossGeoShareDataWithVivaInsights
LogicalName | enablecopilotstudiocrossgeosharedatawithvivainsights
DefaultValue | False

claims.claim: Running the Copilot Studio agents query requires the Insights Analyst role.
claims.quote: Be assigned the role of Insights Analyst in Viva Insights.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The included licensing model is supported by Microsoft Copilot plans including Viva Insights personal, manager, leader and advanced analysis for Copilot-licensed employees.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot plans include a Viva Insights service plan with personal insights as well as manager, leader, and advanced analysis for all employees with a Copilot license.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments creates a directory role assignment.
claims.quote:

POST /roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments

claims.claim: The Graph assignment request selects the role with roleDefinitionId.
claims.quote: Note the use of the roleTemplateId for roleDefinitionId. roleDefinitionId can be either the service-wide template Id or the directory-specific roleDefinitionId.

claims.claim: The cited Microsoft 365 admin center role-assignment steps require Global Administrator.
claims.quote: These steps must be performed by the Microsoft 365 Global Administrator.

claims.claim: Delegated Graph role-assignment access supports Privileged Role Administrator as the least privileged role or a custom role with the required permissions.
claims.quote: the signed-in user must be assigned a supported Microsoft Entra role or a custom role that grants the permissions required for this operation. Privileged Role Administrator is the least privileged role supported for this operation.

claims.claim: Application access requires RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory.
claims.quote:
For the directory (Microsoft Entra ID) provider
Application | RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory

claims.claim: Changing the environment feature settings requires System Administrator or equivalent permissions.
claims.quote: Ensure you have the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions to update the settings.

claims.claim: Both data-sharing and cross-geo sharing can also be controlled for environment groups.
claims.quote: Sharing Copilot Studio agent data with Viva Insights ... You can also control this setting for environment groups. ... Cross-geo boundary sharing ... You can also control this setting for environment groups.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not document an admin UI for deleting all Copilot Studio agents data held in Viva Insights.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Studio agents delete data one month new queries UI; "Viva Insights" "delete" "Copilot Studio" "admin center". Read deletion guide and report deletion section; results document PowerShell, not a UI for this deletion.

claims.claim: The documented deletion script call is .\CopilotAgentsDelete.ps1 -[ClientId] -[TenantId].
claims.quote: .\CopilotAgentsDelete.ps1 -[ClientId] -[TenantId]

claims.claim: The data deletion feature is in preview.
claims.quote: This feature is for public preview customers only. Features in preview might not be complete and could undergo changes before becoming available in the broader release.

claims.claim: Deletion requires a registered application with AdministratorSettings.ReadWrite permission.
claims.quote: Select Workplace Analytics and select Delegated permissions. ... Under Select permissions, select AdministratorSettings.ReadWrite.

claims.claim: The Viva Insights Administrator runs the deletion script.
claims.quote: The Viva Insights Administrator runs a PowerShell cmdlet to delete Copilot Studio agents data in Viva Insights.

claims.claim: Deleting the stored Copilot Studio agents data is irreversible.
claims.quote: If you delete Copilot Studio agents data, the data can't be recovered. ... You can't un-do this deletion.

claims.claim: Deletion makes previous query results unavailable.
claims.quote: Queries you ran before you deleted Copilot Studio agents data are also no longer available to analysts.

claims.claim: After deletion, new queries cannot run for one month.
claims.quote: After the data is deleted, the query won't auto-refresh, and you can't run any new queries for one month.

claims.claim: No dedicated setting excluding only autonomous agents from this report is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Studio agents report exclude autonomous agents setting filter tenant hourly rate multipliers; "Viva Insights" "autonomous agents" "exclude" "setting". Read report, feature settings and analytics page; no dedicated autonomous-only exclusion setting found.
